en.topic_title: Hundreds evacuate in Taiwan ahead of biggest typhoon in decades
en.topic_summary:
By Akio Wang with Joy Chiang in New Taipei City



Hundreds of people in Taiwan have been evacuated from their homes, and many schools and offices closed, as the biggest typhoon in decades sweeps towards the region on Friday.



A man looks on as strong waves break along the coast in Yilan on July 10, 2026, as Typhoon Bavi moves toward northeastern Taiwan. Photo: I-Hwa Cheng/AFP.
